title: Preserve supported lesson meaning and reuse limits
statement: The Lessons and improvement Module shall prepare attributable lesson characterizations with observed and inferred content distinguished, justified reuse and explicit limits, while preserving the selected learning operation's confirmation and custody boundaries.

what.problem: Unsupported causal interpretations can become durable guidance without justified reuse or permitted custody.
what.desired_outcome: Preserve supported lesson meaning and reuse limits.

why.rationale: SR-035 requires this accountable MOD-009 contribution; source meaning, adoption and evidence authority must remain distinct.

stakeholders: Project decision owners and assurance assessors

conditions: During supported finding analysis, work preparation, proposal disposition or opportunity-based effect assessment as applicable; reconsider when the material basis changes.

contexts: MOD-009 contribution to MOD-017 IF-017 consumed by MOD-012; existing controlled-change, assurance and selected retention boundaries.

how.approach: Apply improvement.md to exact participant-supplied context and observations, preserve missing/contrary support, and confirm authority, adopted effects and retention through their existing owners.

how_much.scope: Complete allocated contribution to SR-035 within the declared finite project/activity/observation scope; no automatic causal discovery, policy adoption or universal effectiveness claim.

acceptance_criteria: Bind the finding, original context and observed sources to identifiable content; keep inferred mechanisms and material alternative or contrary explanations distinct from facts.
Explain supported recurrence, reusable weakness or high-consequence broader applicability and its exclusions; an unsupported cause remains provisional and cannot support a conclusive lesson claim.
Return a finding without supported reusable implications to its owning work as a local correction, without manufacturing a durable general rule.

Carry the supplied characterization through IF-017 and the selected artifact/record writer with actual retention distinguished; selected Learn topic/route effects preserve required contributor confirmation, no-clobber and identity-bound retry.
constraints: Existing Learn contributor confirmation and topic/route custody remain applicable to their actual operations; Design approval does not execute them.

sources.basis: Refine supported lesson characterization, bounded contextual use, accountable proposals and opportunity-based effect assessment through MOD-009 and parent IF-017. Preserve existing Learn confirmation/custody/route boundaries and separate controlled adoption, assurance and retention. Proposed Design only.
